Method of Attack: Bypassing permissions to take pictures and record videos via exposed intents in Camera apps
Using Storage permission to access device's SD card and media, then exploiting Camera app intents without required permissions
Taking pictures, recording videos, extracting GPS data from media without permissions
Silencing camera shutter, listening to two-way conversations, transferring historical videos and photos
Attack Vector: Malicious apps with Storage permission exploiting exposed intents in Camera apps
Apps that can read SD card and use Camera app intents without CAMERA, RECORD_AUDIO, ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION permissions
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept app pretending to be a weather app sending pictures, videos, and phone call recordings to command & control server
